tasks.title: Implement api_endpoint using build_url
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's api_endpoint function in pipelines.py is a stub that raises NotImplementedError. It should construct an HTTPS URL for the given host, API version, and resource by delegating to apikit.builders.build_url. The expected format is https://<host>/api/v<version>/<resource>.
tasks.test_context: TestApiEndpoint::test_basic, test_version_1, and test_nested_resource all fail with NotImplementedError because api_endpoint is not implemented.

tasks.title: Implement export_row using flatten_dict and build_csv_row
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's export_row function in pipelines.py is a stub that raises NotImplementedError. It should flatten a nested dictionary using apikit.transforms.flatten_dict, then join the stringified values into a CSV row using apikit.builders.build_csv_row.
tasks.test_context: TestExportRow::test_flat_dict, test_nested_dict, test_mixed, and test_value_with_comma all fail with NotImplementedError because export_row is not implemented.

tasks.title: Implement camel_keys using snake_to_camel
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's camel_keys function in pipelines.py is a stub that raises NotImplementedError. It should transform all dictionary keys from snake_case to camelCase using apikit.transforms.snake_to_camel while preserving the values.
tasks.test_context: TestCamelKeys::test_single_word, test_snake_case, test_empty, and test_multi_segment all fail with NotImplementedError because camel_keys is not implemented.

tasks.title: Implement check_server_config using validate_ip_v4 and validate_port
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's check_server_config function in handlers.py is a stub that raises NotImplementedError. It should validate the host as an IPv4 address using apikit.validators.validate_ip_v4 and the port using apikit.validators.validate_port, collecting error messages for any invalid values.
tasks.test_context: TestCheckServerConfig::test_valid, test_invalid_host, test_invalid_port, test_both_invalid, test_boundary_port_zero, and test_boundary_port_max all fail with NotImplementedError because check_server_config is not implemented.

tasks.title: Implement check_contact using validate_email

tasks.title: Implement tag_line using unique_sorted and pluralize
tasks.problem_statement: The consumer's tag_line function in reports.py is a stub that raises NotImplementedError. It should deduplicate and sort the tags using apikit.transforms.unique_sorted, then format the count with apikit.formatters.pluralize and join the tags.

tasks.title: Implement api_endpoint and export_row in pipelines.py
tasks.problem_statement: Both api_endpoint and export_row in pipelines.py are stubs that raise NotImplementedError. api_endpoint should construct HTTPS URLs via build_url, and export_row should flatten a dict and format it as a CSV row via flatten_dict and build_csv_row.
